name: Cheech & Chong - Singles - Cryo Infused Pre-Roll - Pedro Berry (I)
description:
One joint, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Pedro Berry single is a cryo-infused pre-roll packed with quality flower and infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no setup. Just light it and go.

Pedro Berry brings a sweet, full-bodied profile: ripe mixed berry and dark fruit notes up front, layered with a rich, jammy sweetness and a smooth, earthy finish. Blended with an indica terpene profile for a relaxed, mellow feel — the kind of easy body calm made for evenings and slowing all the way down.

Why you'll love it:

Cryo-infused pre-roll — quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Pedro Berry flavor — ripe berry and dark fruit with a jammy, earthy finish
Indica effects — relaxing and mellow, ideal for evenings
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every joint. Cheech & Chong Pedro Berry is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
